name: shop.catalog
description: Visit residents' shops over the simulated network to discover their current products, sellers and USD-cent prices. Products are not included in your initial knowledge. Decide for yourself whether to buy; contact the seller by email for a quote.

name: shop.quote
description: If you own a shop, prepare a real order and payment reference for an interested buyer. Then send that quote by email. Quoting does not charge anyone or force a purchase. Ask the buyer to put paymentReference in the payment description and return the actual transfer UUID for verification and delivery.

name: shop.orders
description: If you own a shop, inspect your quotes and delivery status.

name: shop.deliver
description: If you own a shop, verify a committed real payment against an order, then deliver the actual product by email. Rejects an incorrect amount, recipient, reference or reused receipt. A repeated completed delivery is not sent again.
